newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cegetel in toll road telecom infrastructure deal.
newsitem.headline: Cegetel in toll road telecom infrastructure deal.

text.p: Generale des Eaux' Cegetel telecoms unit said on Tuesday it had signed a five year deal with the Paris-Rhine-Rhone toll road company (SAPRR) for the use of SAPRR's fibre optic cable network along its roads.

Cegetel will use the cables as an alternative to hiring France Telecom capacity. The network, of more than 1,500 kilometres, will in first instance be used by Generale's SFR mobile telecoms unit and after 1998 for other telecom infrastructure needs as well.
SAPRR has been authorised by the French DGTP telecoms ministry to operate a socalled "alternative" network.
SAPRR could not immediately give any financial information about the deal.
The move is part of the gradual liberalisation of the French telecommunications market.
Cegetel also includes British Telecom Plc and Germany's Mannesmann.
Generale des Eaux, with Mannesmann on Monday also made a bid to run the telecommunications network of state-owned railways SNCF.
Bouygues and Italy's STET have also bid to run this network.
